args.body: Use the current SQLITE-ITCH-PAID-DOWNLOAD-TEST lease and reuse any committed equivalent. Move from policy excerpts to the buyer deliverable. If RELEASE_PACKAGE can identify the exact paid archive and grant for each member, extract it in a clean directory, run the documented learner command, and use the observed result to write the buyer-facing listing. Bind the draft to the archive SHA-256 and include one provisional price, the deductions documented for the selected payment mode, and the exact account or payout prerequisite. If a decisive prerequisite is missing, save a bounded verdict naming the specific file, grant or official seller evidence that would reopen it. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. Keep the draft private. Track listing, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separately.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The itch.io payment and quality pages were retrieved. The next useful step is to turn the existing SQLite exercise into a tested private listing packet if the exact archive has redistribution evidence and the Canadian seller route is documented. Seller activation and independent review govern release. The free preview can proceed separately through its existing review.
